newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Spector "not denying" capital increase plan.
newsitem.headline: Spector "not denying" capital increase plan.

text.p: Belgian Spector Photo Group NV said in a statement on Thursday it "does not deny" plans to increase its capital.
Trade in the company's shares on the Brussels bourse had been suspended earlier pending a statement by the company.
Earlier, financial daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd said Spector was planning a one billion franc capital increase in October to finance recent acquisitions abroad.
Earlier this year, Spector bought a majority stake in Porst a Swiss photo group with operations in Germany and Hungaria.
It also acquired 100 percent of Interdiscount France from Swiss group Interdiscount.
A bourse official could not immediately say when trading in the share would resume.
